slides: What changed when I put protein in every meal
For years, I ate badly and without any system at all.
I felt bad all the time: low energy, heavy, just not like myself.
My weight kept swinging, sometimes too much, sometimes too little. Never stable.
Nothing I ever tried actually stuck for long.
Then I built myself a simple plan: real food, protein in every meal.
Now I feel amazing. Eating like this is easy and actually tasty.
